thread:
alex_chen: Heads-up — seeing a flurry of OTLP export errors from customer-123 private VPC, and Prometheus scrapes are failing. Anyone know where the Grafana dashboard + prometheus job lives for that customer? logs show `503 upstream connect error` and OTLP: `error sending trace export: context deadline exceeded` :thinking:

sara-ng: @alex_chen which region? cust-123 is on eu-west-1, right? I can check forwarding config.

alex_chen: yes eu-west-1. last successful scrape ~ 14:22 UTC.

jordan: Pasting useful links: runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-observability , grafana folder (may be restricted) https://grafana.redwood/eu/d/CUST123/vpc-observability

mike_r: Quick triage steps: check prom-forwarder logs and the local forwarder health. e.g. `kubectl -n obs-forwarder logs prom-forwarder-abc | head -n 200` — did you see entries for customer-123?

alex_chen: ran that, see repeated `dial tcp 10.0.5.23:4317: connect: connection refused` from otlp-forwarder and `scrape_timeout_target` from prometheus. Also some 502/503 in the forwarder logs.

obs-bot: Alert: OTLP Exporter Errors (customer-123) — 5m avg error rate 3/s. Incident: https://incidents.redwood/INC-5398

sara-ng: could be ENI routing or a misconfigured security group. @eng-infra can you check route tables/ENI for customer-123? Also check prom remote_write connection limits.

jordan: If you need dashboard access and it returns 403, I can add you to the Grafana org `cust-123-read`. Confirm and I’ll grant it.

alex_chen: please add me, thanks. Also, these trace-count alerts are noisy while we triage — can we temporarily mute or relax them?

mike_r: propose we relax the rule `otlp_export_error_rate{customer="cust-123"} > 0.5` -> `> 3` for a 30m window. I can open a quick PR to eng-monitoring and tag oncall.

sara-ng: infra confirmed: ENI route missing host-route to the collector IP (10.0.5.23). patching now :hammer_and_wrench: Will post when fixed.

mike_r: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/eng-monitoring/pull/457 — changes alert threshold for cust-123, added note in rule comments. tagging @oncall.

alex_chen: re-checking health: `curl -v http://10.0.5.23:4317/health` now returns 200 OK. OTLP errors dropping in last 2 mins.

jordan: I'll add the grafana link to the runbook and note the temporary alert tuning + ENI fix steps.

alex_chen: resolving here and adding notes to INC-5398. thanks all :tada:

mike_r: follow-up action items: (1) add test to forwarder smoke tests for ENI route presence, (2) add a grafana dashboard snippet to runbook for quick access, (3) monitor for 1h and revert alert threshold if stable.

sara-ng: ack. will watch infra side for 30m.

alex_chen: nice work team :+1:
